evals.prompt: Write a standard Seedance 2.5 restoration prompt for inspected scratches on our authorized 8.375-second fractional archival clip. Final target 1080p. No probe or source trim; preserve the original audio tail.
evals.expected_output: Exact source preservation with separate first-pass native 480p Draft and later inspected 1080p promotion.
expectations: Keeps fractional timing, motion, scene and audio tail; no automatic trimming or padding.
First-pass settings are resolution 480p and boolean draft true; 1080p is only a final delivery target.
Original audio is post-owned, not a regenerated copy; no generation or files.

evals.prompt: Restore the damaged film. No source, frames or diagnosis are available.
evals.expected_output: Material diagnosis remains unresolved; requests source evidence without guessing a defect.
expectations: Does not invent inspected damage or source duration.
Requests accessible source or supplied frame evidence.
Does not generate or write a production package.

evals.prompt: The restoration task says succeeded, but no playback was inspected. The source defect crosses the final frame. Can we splice and pad the end?
evals.expected_output: Technical success is not quality evidence; keeps tail intact until inspection and authorized repair.
expectations: Does not certify defect removal from task success.
Requires inspection of the defect and final frames before splicing.
Does not pad or truncate the source or claim a blanket timing tolerance.

evals.prompt: I selected the clean native Draft, then changed the scratch-removal wording. Prepare promotion settings without replacing the original take.
evals.expected_output: Changed inputs require a new native Draft rather than promotion under old selection.
expectations: Does not attach changed wording to draft_task_id promotion.
Preserves original prompt, take and selection history.
New Draft needs inspection and selection; no submission.
